title: Shooting Script Ser.: American Beauty : The Shooting Script by Sam Mendes
descriptionText:
This is a rare opportunity to get your hands on the shooting script of Sam Mendes' iconic film, "American Beauty." Written by Mendes and Alan Ball, this trade paperback book published by HarperCollins is a must-have for any performing arts or fiction enthusiast. The book includes the original screenplay and is a great addition to any media tie-in collection. 

With a publication year of 1999, this book is a true gem for fans of the film. The language of the book is in English, making it accessible to a wide audience. The book title, "American Beauty: The Shooting Script," is a perfect addition to any book collection. This book falls under the categories of "Books & Magazines" and "Books."
